title: Labia
summary: The labia are the outer (majora) and inner (minora) folds of skin of the vulva that surround and protect the vaginal and urethral openings.
key_points: Inner labia are often longer than the outer ones, and the two sides are often uneven — both are normal.
Colour and size vary widely between people.
